scope: Follow-up to merged PR985: loading feedback, physical house-depth ordering, passable villagers, explicit target approach and one-click doorway portals

diagnosis.entry: User confirmed delayed loading, not a dead button. Foreground Adventure loads and decodes its first-screen assets before navigation; previously no pending feedback. Prior QA preloaded Adventure and masked the first-click wait.
diagnosis.house: Sprite padding put the image-bottom depth line 65 logical pixels in front of the physical house footprint, hiding a player standing at the front wall.
diagnosis.npc: NPC solid rectangles blocked continuous movement. Removed solids; per latest user instruction an explicit NPC click approaches the NPC, while ordinary movement can pass through. Talk remains explicit.

implementation.houseDepth: sortY = physical house footprint front edge; actor uses original foot-y ordering
implementation.npc: No solid rectangle; explicit NPC/chest clicks walk to their approach positions, never automatically talk/search
implementation.portals: Unlocked doors have small two-tier faceted gold SVG markers with highlight, shaded sides and bobbing. Marker center is aligned to the source door opening (38% image width); the approach x uses the same door center. One door/marker click plans movement then enters/exits exactly once at the approach point. Manual movement, new target, blur and leave cancel portal intent. Locked doors have no marker or auto-entry. Door hitboxes exclude roof/transparent padding. Reduced-motion disables bobbing.
implementation.loading: Immediate loading/busy feedback and duplicate-click suppression on original entries; restoration on success/failure/UID cancellation. Artwork quality and asset loading readiness unchanged. No speedup claim.
